how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Everything you need to know about delivery, the deposit, rain and more.
how.deliveryBody: Grab the machine at our downtown spot for free, or book our trips: we drop it off between 8 AM and 9 PM at your door (home or club) or in the parking lot or at the curb next to a court, and/or collect it when you're done. One trip from {trip}, round trip from {round} — priced by distance from downtown.
how.returnBody: Return it to our downtown spot at the end of your rental, or book collection and we'll come to you. Please have it powered off, with the balls back in the bucket — we check the machine and battery, then release your deposit. There's a 30-minute grace period; after that late fees apply (see Pricing → Policies).
how.depositBody: Your rental is charged when you book. The deposit is separate and held on your card — only charged for damage, loss or a late return. Day & weekend: a hold placed 24 h before your rental starts (or at checkout if it's sooner), released when the machine is back in good shape. Week & month: your card is saved instead (no hold).
how.rainBody: This is Victoria — we get it. If it rains on the day your rental starts, tap “Rained out?” in My bookings before your start time: reschedule for free, or take a 100% credit for your next booking.
how.cancelBody: Cancel 48 hours or more before your start time for a full refund. Inside 48 hours you get 50% back. You can cancel or reschedule anytime from “My bookings”.
how.ballsBody: Every rental comes with a full bucket of 100–120 pressureless balls — they keep their bounce and feed consistently. Want more? Add an extra bucket (+50 balls) at checkout. Wet, flat or bald balls can jam the feeder.
how.zoneBody: Trips are priced by straight-line distance from downtown Victoria (the rings on the map). Pins are the public courts we serve — or use your own address.
how.zoneMapLabel: Map of the delivery zones and courts in Victoria
how.stepsSubtitle: Booking to returning, step by step.
how.step1Detail: Pick day, weekend, week or month, a start time and how you want the machine. You pay the rental when you book and tick two boxes for the terms. No account: your booking code and email or phone are enough.
how.step2Detail: Grab it at our downtown spot for free, or we bring it to your door (home or club) or the parking lot next to your court — never onto the court. For day and weekend rentals the {short} deposit hold goes on your card 24 h before you start; week and month rentals just keep your card saved.
how.step3Detail: Power on, pair the PONGBOT app and start a slow drill. The Spotter AI camera tracks your swing and talks you through corrections. The quick-start guide covers jams, voice commands and safety.
how.step4Detail: Bring it back downtown or be there for collection at the agreed time, powered off with the balls in the bucket. We check it and release the deposit. Late? {grace} minutes of grace, then {hourly}/hour up to one day's price. Rain on your start day? Reschedule free or take a credit.

account.a: No. Book with your email or phone number. To see or change your bookings later, open “My bookings” and sign in with a one-time code we send you.

where.a: Wherever you like — at home, at your club or at a public court. Just respect the rules of the place: court time limits, municipal court bookings and whether ball machines are allowed.

delivery.a: Collect and return it at our downtown spot for free, or book our trips: we drop it off and/or collect it at your address, or in the parking lot or at the curb next to a court you choose — never inside the court. Trips are priced by distance from downtown: from {trip} one way or {round} round trip.

balls.a: Yes. Every rental comes with a full bucket of 100–120 pressureless balls. Want more? Add an extra bucket at checkout.

easy.q: Is the machine hard to use?
easy.a: Not at all. We show you everything in five minutes at hand-off. You control it from the PONGBOT app or just by talking to it — voice commands like “more topspin” or “wider angle” — and you get the quick-start guide and a video.

ai.q: What does the AI camera do?
ai.a: The Spotter camera films you at 120 frames per second, tracks you and the ball, analyses your swing and movement and gives you voice tips while you play — plus a movement heatmap afterwards. You can also put it next to the net so it acts as an umpire and keeps score in matches with friends.

coach.a: It includes the Aura S's AI coach: the Spotter camera analyses your swing and movement and gives you voice tips while you play. It's a practice assistant, not a replacement for a professional coach — RallyDrop rents the machine and doesn't give lessons.

court.q: Do I need to book a court?
court.a: No. Use it at home, at your club or at any court you have access to. Court bookings and their rules are between you and the venue.

speed.q: How fast does it go? Is it good for my level?
speed.a: Up to 100 km/h (about 62 mph) in tennis, lobs up to 8 m high, topspin, slice and flat, and up to one ball every 1.5 seconds. It suits beginners through advanced players (up to about NTRP 4.5). Real-world speed varies with spin and settings.

pickleball.q: Can I use it for pickleball?
pickleball.a: Yes — the Aura S is set up for pickleball as well as tennis. Mention it in your booking notes and we'll bring it ready to go.

deposit.a: It's held on your card — only charged for damage, loss or a late return. Day & weekend: a {short} hold, placed 24 h before your rental and released when it's back in good shape. Week & month: your card is saved for up to {long} (no hold). If we ever charge it, we tell you why in writing.

care.a: Optional damage protection you can add at checkout (from {price}). With Care, the most you pay for accidental damage is {cap}. It isn't insurance and doesn't cover theft, loss, use in the rain or gross negligence.

rain.a: Victoria, we know. If it rains on the day your rental starts, open My bookings before your start time and tap “Rained out?”: reschedule for free, or take a credit for 100% of what you paid, valid {months} months and applied automatically to your next booking. On days we declare a rain day, we email you the same options.

late.q: What if I return it late?
late.a: There's a {grace}-minute grace period. After that it's {hourly} per hour late, up to one day's rental price. If we hear nothing for {hours} hours, the machine counts as not returned and the deposit may be charged. Running late? Tell us early — we're flexible when we can be.

breaks.q: What if something breaks or jams?
breaks.a: Stop the machine, switch it off and contact us right away — don't open it. Most jams are a wet or damaged ball: switch off, take it out of the hopper and try again. Normal wear is on us.

friends.a: Yes. Each friend connects their phone to the machine with the PONGBOT app and you take turns. Whoever rents it is responsible for everyone who uses it.

cancel.a: Yes, from “My bookings”. Cancel {hours} hours or more before the start for a full refund, or within {hours} hours for {percent}% back; there's no refund once the rental has started. Rescheduling is free when the new time is available.

insured.a: Yes. RallyDrop carries commercial general liability insurance.
